title: TypeScript conformance
summary: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing durable repository TypeScript and TSX MUST apply the Node.js guidance this policy references together with the configured formatter.
instructions: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing TypeScript MUST read the complete Node.js guidance this policy references, and MUST apply it before completion.
Agents MUST run the configured formatter and type checker before completion and MUST treat formatter output as authoritative.

Workflow-local automation under runtime/logs/workflows/<run-id>/scripts/ MAY be throwaway and need not conform to the repository TypeScript guidance unless it is promoted into durable repository code.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you write, review, or test TypeScript, TSX, or Node.js code.
